name: Material 3 Inspired
description: An independent interpretation of Material Design's public design principles: tonal surfaces tinted by the accent, full pill controls on Material's shape scale with 12px cards and 8px chips, elevated cards held by the two-layer elevation of its tonal levels with no outline, a filled tonal button and filled text fields with one indicator line, outline-variant rules tinted by the accent, 40px controls with wide padding, a 3px ring, and the standard easing with no lift or press nudge. It ships no official component, token file, icon, or font.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, after Material Design's public principles. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's material recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
caveats: Its focus ring is 3px, not the prototype's 2px: at 2px, its rounded corners leave the ring short of the area a 2px ring covers at 3:1.
In forced colors and high contrast, the tonal tint drops with the texture and surfaces read flat; the filled tonal button's transparent border is drawn in the system's button color.
Its tonal tint is 4% of the accent, not Material's 5% to 8% surface tint: over 4%, text-muted and accent-text fall under 4.5:1 on a tinted prominent surface under the brightest dark accents.

tokens.shadow-card: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 30%, transparent), 0 2px 6px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 15%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-overlay: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent), 0 4px 8px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 15%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent), 0 4px 8px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 15%, transparent)
tokens.texture: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 4%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 4%, transparent))
